node.statement: The input to formation has eta <= rho_id^corr, so lem-routef-raw-factor-identities gives tilde-Delta tilde-Upsilon=tilde-Phi. Consequently Upsilon'-tilde-Upsilon=Upsilon'(I-tilde-Phi)+(Upsilon' tilde-Delta-I_B)tilde-Upsilon. Applying the preceding cb estimates and submultiplicativity yields ||Upsilon'-tilde-Upsilon||_cb <= [(1+C_theta)+2*(C_Delta+C_L)]*eta=[1+C_theta+2*C_Delta+2*C_L]*eta=C_Upsilon'*eta by (1.3).
